entities.name: second charcoal driver at the train's west end (faint)
entities.what: A second driver of the charcoal train, very faint, at its west (rear) end, half hidden behind the low west branches of the big bare tree: an adult man in a short robe or jacket, legs apart as if walking, his right arm stretched east toward the last donkey's load. A working man (charcoal driver, 赶脚的).
entities.vis: faded; part: behind the twigs of S1.tree.elm_bare_36660's west limb
entities.note: Outline only, read on contrast-raised crops: body u 36232-36268, v 697-745; feet at about (36240, 766) and (36258, 766); the head top is lost among the twigs (est v ~683); an arm or a stick runs from his shoulder east to about (36275-36320, 702-715), toward D1's panniers. Painted height about 83 px at foot v 766. sections.md counts 2 drivers: this is the second. Other reading: crossing twig strokes only (no head is clear), hence conf low. facing 0 = toward the donkeys (east). The restyle paints two men in hats a little east of here, on D1's panniers: those are not painted. SECOND PASS (start): at zoom 4 (colour and blurred greyscale, wdriver_z4.jpg, wdriver_z4g.jpg) he reads as a figure. Both outlines of a short jacket run at u 36235-36257, v 702-737, with a belt line at v ~737. Two legs stand apart, ending at (36238, 760) and (36258, 765). A roundish head shows at u 36240-36262, v 680-702, crossed by twigs, so the head point stays est. His right arm goes east to (36277, 715). From the hand a thin straight stick runs on east, over D1's west pannier, to about (36320, 705). That is a driving stick held out over the last donkey from behind: a carried prop for the needs list. Facing 0 is right. He drives the train east from its rear.

entities.name: charcoal donkey D1, last in the train (west end)
entities.what: A donkey laden with charcoal: two big bulging panniers slung either side of its back, heaped with dark lumps of charcoal; seen almost end-on, so its head does not show. The rear (westmost) donkey of the train, with the faint second driver just west of it.
entities.vis: part: head hidden (seen end-on, behind D2's rump)
entities.note: Load u 36283-36343, v 732-790 (two panniers 60 px across, lumpy charcoal tops at v 732-745); thin legs end at (36294, 796), (36315, 802) and (36331, 806). BOTH READINGS of the facing (conf low on it): the pale rounded mass on the west pannier (u 36285-36312, v 752-785, with dark marks like eyes) is either its face seen from the front (facing south-west, toward the viewer) or its pale rump seen from behind (facing south-east after D2, as the other donkeys do); 315 is taken from the file and the head est at the east end. The restyle paints two men in hats here (it reads the two panniers as two men). SCALE CUE: 74 px from the load's top to the hooves. SECOND PASS (start): D1 is a side view like D2, not end-on. Its three legs end 37 px apart along u ((36294, 796), (36315, 802), (36331, 806)), as D2's do (36351-36417), and its load is two bundles along its back, as D2's 'two baskets' are. Its head is the dark lowered shape at its east end, u 36332-36350, v 765-802, between its forelegs and D2's rump (greyscale zoom 6, d1_z6g.jpg; zoom 4, d12_z4.jpg): head and neck hang low, muzzle near v 800, as D2's and D3's do. The pale rounded mass with 'eyes' on its west bundle (36285-36312, 752-785) is the pannier's weave pattern. The restyle reads the two bundles as two men. Facing 330 as D2 and D3, the file's direction. Conf on the facing low -> med.

entities.name: charcoal donkey D2, head hanging low
entities.what: A donkey with two baskets heaped with dark charcoal lumps on its pack saddle, its head hanging low at its east end; walking in the file between D1 and D3.
entities.note: Load u 36357-36411, v 757-790 (two baskets); body u 36343-36420, v 771-812; the head is a lowered wedge at u 36407-36435, v 800-815, read as the head with the ears forward (other reading: a swishing tail, which would make it face west: conf med on the facing). Legs end at (36351, 829), (36380, 843), (36403, 821) and (36417, 831). SCALE CUE: body 77 px long, 80 px from the load's top to the hooves.

entities.name: charcoal donkey D3, head hanging low by the big tree
entities.what: A donkey with a basket of charcoal on its back, its head and neck hanging low at its east end against the big bare tree's trunk; walking in the file between D2 and D4.
entities.note: Rounded rump at the west end (u 36437-36451, v 821-845); load u 36471-36511, v 807-825; head and neck lowered to u 36505-36540, v 835-863, among the trunk lines of S1.tree.elm_bare_36660 (other reading: its tail, facing west: conf med on the facing). Legs end at (36443, 885), (36458, 880), (36498, 880) and (36517, 885). SCALE CUE: 103 px from rump to muzzle, 78 px from the load's top to the hooves.

entities.name: charcoal donkey D4, head up and ears pricked
entities.what: A donkey with a dark pannier load, head raised and both long ears pricked up at its east end, its muzzle against the west side of D5's panniers; the big bare tree's trunk hides the middle of its body.
entities.vis: part: the trunk of S1.tree.elm_bare_36660 hides its hind half
entities.note: Head u 36677-36700, v 830-872 (ear tips v 830, muzzle at (36697, 868)); the neck rises from the body's east end (u 36650-36670); body and pannier u 36620-36673, v 833-883 east of the trunk; front legs end at (36658, 913) and (36675, 917); two hind hooves at u 36583-36590, v 903-910 just west of the trunk. The setup brief read it as 'head turned'; on the strokes the whole body faces east like D2 and D3, so it is not turned back. SCALE CUE: 87 px from the hooves to the ear tips; 115 px from the hind hooves to the muzzle.

entities.name: charcoal donkey D5, the leader, with woven panniers
entities.what: The leading donkey, carrying two big hatched (woven wicker) panniers of charcoal, one on each side, seen nearly end-on with its head lowered between them toward the viewer; the east driver's right hand rests on the top of its load.
entities.note: Panniers u 36697-36773, v 857-913 (76 px across, hatched like wickerwork, dark charcoal heaped at the top, v 857-870); legs end at (36713, 932), (36730, 937), (36748, 940) and (36760, 947). BOTH READINGS (conf low on the facing): the dark upright shape between the panniers (u 36732-36747, v 875-935) is its lowered head seen from the front (facing the viewer and a little east, taken) or its rump and tail seen from behind (facing north-west). D4's muzzle touches its west pannier.

entities.name: charcoal driver with a switch, at the train's east end
entities.what: Adult man, the charcoal train's driver (赶脚的): a wide round-brimmed hat, a short jacket belted over trousers, legs apart; he leans west toward the leading donkey with his right arm stretched to the top of its load (holding the load or its lead) and holds a long switch out to the east in his left hand, its tip hanging down. His face, under the hat, is turned west toward the donkeys.
entities.note: Hat brim u 36780-36810, v 831-842; feet at (36783, 921) and (36810, 928); right hand at (36755, 860) on D5's load; left hand at about (36840, 855), the switch running on to (36853, 900). Painted height 94 px at foot v 925 (diminution pair). BOTH READINGS of his walk: he walks east in front of the train leading D5 and looks back (the donkeys' heads point east), or he drives the train from behind toward the west and the city (赶驴入城, the scholarship's reading); facing 200 = his body and face turned to the donkeys. The restyle paints 6-8 men in blue round the train: only he and S1.fig.charcoal_driver_36250 are painted.

entities.name: the charcoal donkey train (赶驴入城)
entities.what: Two drivers bring five donkeys laden with charcoal through the bare trees north of the small bridge, in a file running from the north-west (the rear, with a faint driver behind the last donkey) down to the south-east, where the man with a switch stands at the leading donkey by the big tree at the bridge's east end, leaning back to it with a hand on its load. As painted the donkeys' heads point east and down toward the bridge's east end; the scholarship (赶驴入城) has the train bound for the city, to the west.
entities.src: 名画记: 赶驴入城 (pin 1); 余辉: 赶驴入城
entities.note: Counted on the scan head by head: 5 donkeys, 2 men (sections.md's 5 donkeys and 2 drivers confirmed; the restyle's 6-8 men are invented). Order from the east (front): S1.ani.donkey_charcoal_36745, _36666, _36508, _36410, _36323. DIRECTION (contradicts the brief's 'walking west' and the restyle): D4's head with pricked ears is at its east end beyond doubt, and D2's and D3's lowered heads read at their east ends; D1 and D5 are seen nearly end-on. The file's path runs from (36294, 797) to (36760, 947), slope 0.32 (down toward the viewer to the east): a walking line, not a ground edge. SECOND PASS (start), on the direction (the lead's decision): every head that can be read is at the east end. D4: ears and muzzle, high. D3: rump west, head lowered at 36505-36540. D2: lowered head at 36407-36435. D1: lowered head at 36332-36350, a side view (see its note). D5 comes toward the viewer: between its panniers a broad dark shape, 17 px wide (36733-36750), tapers to a rounded end at v ~932, too broad for a tail, so it is a lowered head seen from the front (290 stands). The west man holds a stick out east over D1's load: he drives from behind. The east man stands at the front and holds D5's load while it comes down to him. So as painted the train walks east-south-east, down toward the bridge's east end (the leader is already 140-190 px east of it, at 36745-36797). Nothing on the strokes turns it west. 赶驴入城 is the scholarship's title, not a stroke reading. The routine in people.json should walk it east along S1.road.main as mapped.

entities.name: small empty boat (sampan) moored under the small bridge
entities.what: A small open wooden boat (a sampan), empty: no crew, mast, cabin, sweep or cargo. It lies along the bank just south of the small bridge, a raised square end (transom) to the west and a raised pointed end to the east, with one thwart near the east end. A thin upright pole stands in the stream at its pointed east end (S1.prop.mooring_pole_36444): the boat is tied to it.
entities.src: sections.md §2: mist, sparse trees and water at the very start
entities.note: Outline only, in thin lines: a vertical stroke for the west end's transom (u 36175-36183, v 1131-1150); the far gunwale (36180, 1132) -> (36293, 1157) -> (36440, 1180); the near gunwale (36193, 1160) -> (36327, 1190) -> (36437, 1190); the bottom's curve (36353, 1210) -> (36440, 1187) up to the pointed end; a thwart tick at (36397, 1175-1180). SCALE CUE: hull 262 px long and 30-40 px deep, at v 1130-1210. front = the pointed east end, which the line ties to the bridge (S1.str.small_bridge_36365, a post foot at about (36445, 1100)); no rudder or sweep shows, so which end is the bow is a reading (conf low on it). BOTH READINGS of the water: afloat in the stream at the bank's edge (support 'stream', taken: the mooring line, and the plain silk round it is the same as under the bridge) or drawn up on the bank (the bank's wash strokes run under its west half, (36207, 1180) -> (36333, 1227)). The restyle draws it about 30 px south-east of the outline, on dry ground with grass: not used. No crew, so no group. MERGE: the rope's far end is the foot of a post of S1.str.small_bridge_36365 (its bays, at about (36445, 1100)). No rudder, sweep or side sweeps are painted, so the lead's bow rule (rudder or sweep = rear) cannot be applied: front stays the pointed east end tied to the bridge, conf low. SECOND PASS (start): AFLOAT, confirmed. The hull lies wholly on pale silk. Its near gunwale (36193, 1160) -> (36327, 1190) runs 20-35 px north of S1.grd.spit_under_boat_36140's north edge (36250, 1210) -> (36335, 1228). The dark stroke under its west half, (36207, 1180) -> (36327, 1223), is that spit's edge, not ground under the boat. The west transom (36173-36187, 1127-1160) is about 70 px east of the west bank's foot (S1.grd.bank_36060: (36105, 1110), (36075, 1180)). Support stream stands. BOW: still unreadable. No rudder, sweep or side sweep is drawn; the west end is a raised square transom and the east end lower and pointed. front = east stays, conf low. THE LINE at its east end is vertical at u 36442-36446, v about 1125-1180. It stops 40-60 px below the nearest bridge post foot (36455, 1063), and no post stands at (36445, 1100). It is proposed as its own prop, S1.prop.mooring_pole_36444 (a pole in the stream bed the boat is tied to). If accepted, read 'the line' in this note and in `what` as that pole.

entities.name: far tree with fans of shoots at the top (west)
entities.what: A far tree near the top of the silk, painted in pale ink: from a head at about (36303, 310) fans of long, fine, straight pale shoots rise and spread over a faint short trunk. A far willow with rising fans of shoots (willow_fan, drawn small and far), or a pine-like tree (pine_fan). Bare or a faint haze.
entities.vis: part: trunk below v 410 hidden by the big bare tree's west limb
entities.src: sections.md §2: mist, sparse trees and water at the very start
entities.note: Fans u 36245-36450, v 192-345, springing from about (36298-36309, 288-327); a pale trunk u 36292-36309 shows down to v ~410, then the twigs of S1.tree.elm_bare_36660 cover it. Base est: unknown between v 450 and 760, taken on the far ground behind the west driver (v 700). BOUNDARY: base u 36300 is t7's east edge; if t7 also records it, keep one. The fans east of u 36440 may be its east limb or S1.tree.far_fan_tree_36465's.

entities.name: pale far tree behind the big bare tree
entities.what: A tall far tree painted in pale ink behind the big bare tree: a straight pale grey trunk and, at the top of the silk, faint wide fans of long fine straight shoots; a far willow with rising fans of shoots (willow_fan) or a pine-like tree (pine_fan). Bare or a faint haze.
entities.vis: part: trunk below v 790 hidden by the donkeys D2 and D3; crown faint
entities.src: sections.md §2: mist, sparse trees and water at the very start
entities.note: Pale trunk u 36455-36480 from v ~425 down to v ~790, behind D2 and D3; faint fans at u 36445-36536, v 172-218, u 36490-36605, v 286-377 and u 36627-36695, v 323-395. Base est on the ground behind the train. The dark knotted limb crossing its top at (36450-36480, 360-430) is S1.tree.elm_bare_36660's. Other reading: the fans are a separate far crown and the pale trunk a bare pole. The restyle paints a straight trunk here too.

entities.name: big bare elm-like tree at the small bridge's east end
entities.what: A big old bare tree (elm-like, elm_claw form): a thick gnarled trunk rises from roots spread over the stream bank at the small bridge's east end and leans north-west, forking at about v 700 into a limb up to the crown's top, a long low limb sweeping west over the charcoal train and a limb to the east; every branch ends in dark crab-claw twig clusters, no leaves. The donkey train passes behind (north of) its trunk.
entities.src: sections.md §2: mist, sparse trees and water at the very start
entities.note: Trunk u 36610-36653 at v 940-1000; roots over the bank from u 36630 to 36770 at v 1040-1095; base at the trunk's foot. The bridge deck's east end meets the trunk at about (36640, 1030) (structures_e's). Painted height 723 px. The west limb's twigs reach about u 36160 (v 550-600), over t7's range.

entities.name: tall slender bare tree with its crown bent west
entities.what: A tall slender bare tree east of the train: a thin dark trunk rising almost straight from the bank to a small crown of crab-claw twigs, whose limbs bend over and reach far west (slender form, like its card 2, 'a long curve to the west'); no leaves. The leaning pole S1.prop.leaning_pole_37075 rests across its trunk.
entities.src: sections.md §2: mist, sparse trees and water at the very start
entities.note: Trunk u 37013-37047 from v 330 down to its foot at about v 850, where the bank's ink wash meets it; crown u 36835-37115, v 242-370. Painted height 608 px. SECOND PASS (start): the base is at the trunk's centre, not on its east outline. Row profiles (1-px columns, 10 px bands) find the trunk's outlines at u 36995-37000 and 37020-37025 for v 800-830. Below that the west outline flares out to a root spread at 36965-36985 (v 840-860), and the east outline stays at 37015-37020. Foot centre about (37000, 852); the mapped 37018 is the east outline. Small (18 px), for consistency with how the other feet were taken.

entities.name: big forked bare elm-like tree at the scroll's start
entities.what: A big bare elm-like tree (elm_claw form) on the bank at the scroll's start: a thick gnarled trunk from spreading roots forks low into three main limbs, one rising north-west, one up to the crown's top and a long one reaching far east toward the silk's edge, all ending in crab-claw twig clusters; a short cut or broken limb stub juts from a limb at about (37235, 600). No leaves. A pole leans against the trees at its foot.
entities.src: sections.md §2: mist, sparse trees and water at the very start
entities.note: Trunk u 37050-37140 at v 813-880 going down to roots u 37100-37205 at v 930-960; the fork at about (37110, 800). The low twigs east of the fork (u 37240-37330, v 740-820) are its low east limb, not a separate shrub. The crown's east tips reach u 37568, below and beside the seals (u 37250-37500, v 100-320; u 37410-37540, v 800-1000), which are never recorded. Painted height 565 px.

entities.name: pole leaning against the trees
entities.what: A straight pole or cut timber, about as thick as a branch, leaning across the slender tree's trunk: its foot on the ground against the west side of the big forked tree's trunk, its squared upper end sticking out north-west past the slender tree. Left there by someone.
entities.src: sections.md §2: mist, sparse trees and water at the very start
entities.note: Parallel edges about 10-12 px apart, from the squared upper end at (36986-36999, 694-702) to the foot at (37072-37080, 821-830), crossing S1.tree.slender_bare_37018's trunk at about (37035, 750); 140 px long. BOTH READINGS: a cut pole or timber leaned on the tree (taken: the squared end and straight edges) or a dead limb broken off S1.tree.elm_bare_37140 and fallen against the slender tree. The foot meets the big tree's trunk, so its ground point is est. The line is elevated (slope 1.54), not a ground edge.
